correctness.rationale: Exact graph-state character sum gives flat nonzero spectrum with cardinality equal to the modular cross-image. The cut-matrix row-sum decomposition and \(H=Z\operatorname{diag}((-2)^{|T|-1})Z^{\top}\) are integer identities; the constant-vector intersection follows from \(H(2H-J)=2^{m-1}I\) and \(H\mathbf1=2^{m-1}\mathbf1\). The derived modular rank for every integer dimension determines the complete rectangular Smith form. Reproducibility checker passed 32 explicit tests, including independent exact Smith calculations and a full 15-qubit spectrum; the theorem is analytically proved for unbounded m and D.

value.rationale: A canonical union of two complementary maximal binary commuting contexts defines a natural nontrivial cut in the binary symplectic noncommutation network. It has an all-dimensional exact entanglement spectrum and an integral invariant-factor classification, not a finite numerical slice. Odd-dimensional graph states lose exactly one dit while qubit entropy is only \(2m\) bits out of \(2(2^m-1)\), providing a structural dyadic separation. The compatibility lemma is mathematically meaningful beyond the known single-context incidence SNF.
